_comment: Titles are EARNED, not chosen. A background (player/backgrounds.json) decides where you begin; a title is what you have become, claimed with 'title <name>' once its conditions hold. Titles grant nothing mechanical -- no stats, no spells, no access. They are identity and social signal, which is what a class was doing badly. Conditions are evaluated by engine/conditions.py; see that module for the full condition language.
_conferring: A 'conferred_by' block names the guild-like construct that recognises the title. Content decides whether that group is a guild, an order, a college, a crew, or a lodge -- the engine only knows it as a group that confers names.

hand.name: Hand
hand.description: You have done enough honest work that people ask for you by name.

wright.name: Wright
wright.description: You can be trusted with a commission and left alone to finish it.

trader.name: Trader
trader.description: You know what a thing is worth and you do not embarrass yourself at the stall.

factor.name: Factor
factor.description: Talia lets you see her ledgers. In Riverside, that is a career.

fieldhand.name: Fieldhand
fieldhand.description: You have learned where things grow, and in what season, and how to get there.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.description: You have been out past the walls more than once, and come back with something to show for it.

pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
pathfinder.description: You have walked the far country and can speak for what lives there.

collector.name: Collector
collector.description: Vane has started saving you a chair, and asking what you have found lately.

hedge_healer.name: Hedge Healer
hedge_healer.description: You know which plants help and which only smell like they might. People come to you before they go to the shrine.

dawnsworn.name: Dawnsworn
dawnsworn.description: The Order has stopped calling you a visitor. You are one of theirs now, whether or not you meant to be.

quiet_hand.name: Quiet Hand
quiet_hand.description: You have learned to take what is not watched for, and to be elsewhere when the counting starts.

locksmith.name: Locksmith
locksmith.description: Doors have stopped being an obstacle and started being a conversation.

friend_of_riverside.name: Friend of Riverside
friend_of_riverside.description: Enough people in this village would speak for you that you could probably get away with something. You have not.
